note: The money goals stay red until hq/data/spend.json exists. A balance nothing records is not a number this page may draw — the ledger's own figures do not reconcile with the vendor by about twenty cents, and charting prose would launder that gap.

goals.statement: Every pound this studio spends is written somewhere a machine can read.
goals.statement_short: there is no machine-readable record of what this studio spends
goals.why_it_matters: The whole spend record is prose inside an essay, and it does not reconcile: the ledger's figures imply about $1.27 remaining, and the last balance actually written down was $1.858 before two runs that recorded no balance at all. Nobody in this studio can state today's balance, which is precisely the number an approval should be given against.

path_to_green.narrative: One record per paid call — date, purpose, dollars, and the balance the vendor returned afterwards — written by the pipeline as it spends. Backfilled from the ledger's existing figures, with the unreconciled tail marked as unreconciled rather than smoothed over.

goals.statement: Nothing ships whose rights we have not written down.

goals.why_it_matters: One build is public and the store page names no contact of any kind. The first thing a first player would tell us is the one thing we cannot hear.

path_to_green.narrative: Itch comments, an email alias, or a plain line saying there is nowhere — all three are fine. Only the omission is not, and it is a public promise about your own time, so it is yours to make.

action.label: Draft the three options
